tasks.label: Android: Run on Emulator (Dance4Life)
tasks.command: cd Dance4Life/AndroidSensor && bash ./gradlew assembleDebug && AVD_NAME=${D4L_AVD:-$(emulator -list-avds | head -n 1)} && if [ -z "dance4life_api35" ]; then echo 'No emulator AVD found. Create one in Android Studio Device Manager or set D4L_AVD.'; exit 1; fi && adb start-server && if ! adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | grep -q .; then nohup emulator -avd "$AVD_NAME" -netdelay none -netspeed full >/tmp/dance4life-emulator.log 2>&1 & fi && adb wait-for-device && until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do echo 'Waiting for emulator boot...'; sleep 2; done && adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb shell am start -n com.example.dance4life_phone/.ui.MainActivity
